items.title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
items.summary: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. Author Mike Major cautions against jumping to conclusions, however, noting that business cycle shifts and remote work trends could also explain the numbers. The article Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service appeared first on The Decoder .
items.so_what: Primeras señales macroeconómicas de que la automatización por IA está afectando desproporcionadamente a los jóvenes en roles de software y servicio al cliente. Indica una transformación estructural del mercado laboral.
